name: shadow_tier2_detailed
description: Detailed shadow path calculations for specified dates and times. Configurable for jurisdiction-specific requirements (point-in-time for NYC, time ranges for Boston). Based on UT_Hackathon prototype.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction for analysis. Determines analysis methodology and default parameters.

analysis_dates.description: List of dates for shadow analysis (ISO format: YYYY-MM-DD). Common dates include summer/winter solstice, spring/fall equinox.

time_points.description: Specific times for analysis (HH:MM format). Auto-populated based on jurisdiction.

latitude.description: Latitude for solar calculations (auto-detected from geometry if not provided)

longitude.description: Longitude for solar calculations (auto-detected from geometry if not provided)

shadow_geometries.description: Calculated shadow polygons for each time point

affected_area_sqft.description: Total affected area in square feet

analysis_summary.description: Summary statistics including max shadow length, times of max impact, etc.

summary_report.description: Detailed text report of shadow analysis

visualization.description: Interactive map showing shadow paths for all analyzed times
